title: DreamBall Memory Palace Archiform Schema
description: Per-archiform JSON Schema for the Memory Palace archiform (D-018, D-017). Canonical field shapes for all Memory Palace node and relationship tables, derived faithfully from src/memory-palace/schema.cypher and the Memory-Palace-specific types in src/protocol_v2.zig. TRANSLATION ONLY — no semantic change. The CBOR encoding algorithm stays canonical in Zig (src/*.zig) with golden test vectors. Generated outputs (Zig, TS, Valibot, Cypher DDL) are Story 2.2 deliverables. x-extension keys (x-zig, x-zig-type, x-cbor, x-cbor-section, x-wire-type, x-format-version, x-cypher-table, x-cypher-kind, x-cypher-rel-pairs, x-merge-key, x-merge-key-derivation) carry generator hints; validators ignore them, generators consume them. D-028: Triple is a schema citizen with fp MERGE key = blake3(agent_fp || '\0' || subject || '\0' || predicate || '\0' || object); Agent.knowledge_graph STRING is NOT present (removed per D-028). IC1: archiform_fp is declared as an optional surface so codegen is ready for Story 2.3 (genesis envelope extension ships in Story 2.3, not here).

PalaceNode.$comment: Per schema.cypher CREATE NODE TABLE Palace. Primary graph node for a Memory Palace instance.

fp.$comment: PRIMARY KEY — blake3 fingerprint of the palace genesis envelope.

guild_fps.$comment: STRING[] DEFAULT [] — array of guild fingerprints.

archiform_fp.$comment: IC1 — optional archiform_fp surface for Story 2.3 genesis envelope extension. Declared here so codegen is ready; the envelope field itself ships in Story 2.3.

RoomNode.$comment: Per schema.cypher CREATE NODE TABLE Room.

InscriptionNode.$comment: Per schema.cypher CREATE NODE TABLE Inscription (RC1, RC3). Carries policy + revision columns; source_blake3 is the asset hash; orphaned written by file-watcher (S4.4); embedding is FLOAT[256] for kNN recall.

orphaned.$comment: RC1: BOOL DEFAULT false — set by file-watcher (S4.4).

embedding.$comment: FLOAT[256] — kNN embedding vector. Null until embedding run.

policy.$comment: DEFAULT 'public'. Access policy gate for getInscription.

revision.$comment: INT64 DEFAULT 0 — incremented by file-watcher on reembed.

surface.$comment: Open-enum surface from jelly.inscription wire type; e.g. scroll, tablet, book-spread.

placement.$comment: auto = renderer chooses; curator = parent room's jelly.layout.

AgentNode.$comment: Per schema.cypher CREATE NODE TABLE Agent (S4.1). Carries 4 slot columns as JSON strings. knowledge_graph STRING is NOT present — removed per D-028 (Triple-native KG storage). knowledge graph is now modelled as Triple nodes via HAS_KNOWLEDGE rel.

memory.$comment: JSON array of memory entries (empty at mint). DEFAULT '[]'.

interaction_set.$comment: JSON array of interaction records (empty at mint). DEFAULT '[]'.

TripleNode.$comment: Per schema.cypher CREATE NODE TABLE Triple + D-028. Native KG triple row — one per (agent, subject, predicate, object) tuple. Replaces the prior Agent.knowledge_graph STRING DEFAULT '[]' JSON blob. fp MERGE key derivation: blake3(agent_fp || '\0' || subject || '\0' || predicate || '\0' || object). Idempotent insert via fp existence check. CBOR wire format on ActionLog envelopes; Triple rows are derived state replayable from ActionLog per D-021.

fp.$comment: PRIMARY KEY — deterministic MERGE key. Derivation: blake3(agent_fp || '\0' || subject || '\0' || predicate || '\0' || object). Per D-028.

agent_fp.$comment: Foreign key to Agent.fp — the oracle agent that owns this triple.

MythosNode.$comment: Per schema.cypher CREATE NODE TABLE Mythos. Stores the canonicality tag and discovered_in_action_fp as a STRING property (not a relationship) per AC2/D-016.

discovered_in_action_fp.$comment: DISCOVERED_IN is NOT a relationship — stored as Mythos.discovered_in_action_fp STRING per AC2/D-016.

AqueductNode.$comment: Per schema.cypher CREATE NODE TABLE Aqueduct + src/protocol_v2.zig Aqueduct (PROTOCOL.md §13.4). All 6 AC1-required properties: resistance, capacitance, strength, conductance, phase, last_traversal_ts. Note: the wire-protocol field is last-traversed (Aqueduct struct in protocol_v2.zig); the DB column is last_traversal_ts (schema.cypher). This is a faithful translation of both sources — the cypher column name takes precedence for the DB schema citizen shape.

conductance.$comment: DOUBLE DEFAULT 0.0 — snapshot accumulator; not load-bearing (TC16).

phase.$comment: STRING DEFAULT 'standing'. Open-enum phase; known values: in, out, standing, resonant.

last_traversal_ts.$comment: INT64 DEFAULT 0 — Unix timestamp ms of last traversal. DB column name; wire-protocol field is last-traversed.

ActionLogNode.$comment: Per schema.cypher CREATE NODE TABLE ActionLog. The logical commit record per D-021 (LadybugDB transactional model). ActionLog is the truth; rows derived from it can be regenerated by replaying envelopes from CAS. RC2: action_kind STRING accepts all 9 known action kinds.

fp.$comment: PRIMARY KEY — blake3 of the CBOR action envelope.

action_kind.$comment: RC2: open-string accepting all 9 action kinds. Examples: palace-minted, room-added, avatar-inscribed, aqueduct-created, move, true-naming, inscription-updated, inscription-orphaned, inscription-pending-embedding.

parent_hashes.$comment: STRING[] — array of parent action blake3 hashes.

cbor_bytes_blake3.$comment: blake3 hex of the raw CBOR envelope bytes — CAS content address.

ContainsRel.$comment: Per schema.cypher CREATE REL TABLE CONTAINS. Multi-pair containment edges: Palace→Room, Room→Inscription, Palace→Inscription, Palace→Agent. Single rel table covering all containment in the Memory Palace.

MythosHeadRel.$comment: Per schema.cypher CREATE REL TABLE MYTHOS_HEAD. Unique 1-edge pointer from Palace to its current head Mythos.

PredecessorRel.$comment: Per schema.cypher CREATE REL TABLE PREDECESSOR. Mythos chain — each Mythos points to its predecessor.

LivesInRel.$comment: Per schema.cypher CREATE REL TABLE LIVES_IN. Inscription lives in a Room (complement to CONTAINS Room→Inscription).

AqueductFromRel.$comment: Per schema.cypher CREATE REL TABLE AQUEDUCT_FROM. Aqueduct originates from a Room.

AqueductToRel.$comment: Per schema.cypher CREATE REL TABLE AQUEDUCT_TO. Aqueduct terminates at a Room.

KnowsRel.$comment: Per schema.cypher CREATE REL TABLE KNOWS. Reserved for oracle/quorum graph — Agent→Agent knowledge edges. Defined upfront even if unused in Epic 2.

HasKnowledgeRel.$comment: Per schema.cypher CREATE REL TABLE HAS_KNOWLEDGE + D-028. Agent owns a set of Triple nodes in its knowledge graph. Replaces the prior Agent.knowledge_graph JSON STRING column. Per D-028: HAS_KNOWLEDGE rel from Agent to Triple is declared as a schema citizen.
